hardware: NVIDIA A100 GPU for latency evaluation

settings.name: budgets
settings.description: 10,20,30,40,50,60% of routed top-k expert slots skipped; top-1 always retained.

settings.name: threshold mapping
settings.description: one unlabeled full-model pass collects selection scores and quantile-maps requested budgets; estimator tables remain parameter-only.

settings.name: downstream
settings.description: zero-shot, identical prompts/splits, greedy decoding; max generation 1024 for ARC-C/E/PIQA, 2048 for reasoning/coding.

settings.name: reproducibility
settings.description: single deterministic run seed 42; paper cautions against overinterpreting sub-point differences.

settings.name: latency
settings.description: 60% skipping on A100; lengths 256–1024 and batch sizes 1–4; TTFT/TPOT.

data.correctness: Lossy expert skipping; exact BF16 output equivalence is not guaranteed. Top-1 is always retained and surviving gates renormalized.
data.methodology: Equal realized expert-slot budgets across methods; three MoE models, eight benchmarks, component/fusion ablations, threshold-preparation timing, and A100 TTFT/TPOT.
data.scope: Supports quality-vs-executed-expert and single-GPU latency claims. Distributed expert-parallel serving is not evaluated; thresholds are workload-matched and quality uses one deterministic run.
